summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Gemini 2.5 Flash AI integration (Ask Essay + Admin Writing Assistant) with streaming SSE. All backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend widgets functional with streaming responses. Regression tests passed.

design_issues.issue: Error toast validation could not be verified in automated test (toast may appear/disappear quickly)
design_issues.note: Validation logic exists in code (line 27-29 of AiAssistantDialog.js), but toast visibility timing makes it hard to test. Not a functional bug.

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/posts/{slug}/ask streams SSE with grounded answers (mentions momentum/clarity/lesson)
Backend: /ask validation - 422 for 500+ char questions, 404 for nonexistent slug
Backend: POST /api/admin/ai/assist requires admin auth (401 without token, 422 for invalid mode)
Backend: /admin/ai/assist streams SSE and polishes text correctly
Backend Regression: GET /api/posts (200), GET /api/posts/{slug} (200), audio endpoint cached (200), analytics (200)
Frontend: Article page shows 'Ask this essay' widget below article
Frontend: Can type question and receive streaming assistant reply (307 chars)
Frontend: Follow-up questions work with history (2 assistant messages)
Frontend: Admin editor loads, AI assistant button opens dialog
Frontend: Generate draft from notes works (4738 chars generated)
Frontend: Replace draft button fills content textarea correctly
Frontend: Audio narrator component present on article page
Frontend: No console crashes or errors during testing

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (all core features working, minor toast validation timing issue)
